properties.statement: Wrote queries measuring the HEALTH OF IDEA LINKING across the whole idea population: how many ideas carry at least one semantic relation, how many carry the explicit "nothing was related" note, how many carry neither, what node types ideas connect to, and a two-hop reachability walk to check a neighbourhood was genuinely connected rather than merely named in prose. The unreviewed count is computed internally and drives a gap, but the BREAKDOWN — linked versus deliberately noted versus silent — is what separates "nobody looked" from "looked and found nothing", and nothing serves it. find_tools over all 164 served tools returned relation_candidates and review_relations: both offer or record relations, neither measures whether the discipline is followed.
